instruction: Cinematic film still, full-body shot. On a shaded dirt path in a lush green forest, the dark-haired woman in a cream ruffled dress (R1) walks on the left, pointing forward and upward with her raised right hand. Beside her, the short-haired woman in a white ruffled blouse and tan trousers (R2) walks on the right, looking up in the direction of the gesture. R2's left arm remains linked through R1's right arm. Soft, diffused daylight filters through the dense green canopy, creating a natural, serene atmosphere.
elements: R1 points forward and upward with her raised right hand while R2 looks up in the direction of R1's gesture
R2's left arm is linked through R1's right arm
R1 serves as the gesturing guide while R2 attends to where R1 points
R1 and R2 walk beside each other with their arms linked
They are on a shaded dirt path in a lush green forest
